Service business

For businesses that generate leads and convert them through calls, WhatsApp, meetings or sales teams.

  • Clinics
  • Salons
  • Real estate services
  • Consultants
  • Lawyers
  • Interior designers
  • Architects

B2B

For businesses selling to other businesses through discovery calls, demos, proposals and longer sales cycles.

  • SaaS
  • IT services
  • Agencies
  • Manufacturers
  • Wholesalers
  • Staffing
  • Consultancies
Lead → Qualified → Discovery call → Proposal → Deal

B2C / E-commerce

For brands selling products directly to consumers online, where orders, returns and repeat purchases decide profit.

  • Fashion
  • Beauty
  • Home decor
  • Electronics
  • Food
  • Toys & kids
  • D2C brands
Click → Page view → Cart → Checkout → Order
